# NPMplus Provider

Use the NPMplus provider to interact with resources from NPMplus.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Configuration-based authentication
provider "npmplus" {
  url      = "http://localhost:81"
  username = "admin@example.com"
  password = "changeme"
}

# Environment variable-based authentication
provider "npmplus" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `password` (String, Sensitive) Password for NPMplus authentication. Can be specified via the `NPMPLUS_PASSWORD` environment variable.
- `url` (String) Full NPMplus URL with protocol and port (e.g. `http://localhost:81`). You should **NOT** supply any path (`/api`), the SDK will use the appropriate paths. Can be specified via the `NPMPLUS_URL` environment variable.
- `username` (String) Username for NPMplus authentication. Can be specified via the `NPMPLUS_USERNAME` environment variable.
